  - text: CLASS 11 • CONIC SECTIONS
  - heading "Tangent to an Ellipse" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Explore the tangent to the ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 at a point P(a cos θ, b sin θ). Move the slider to see the tangent, intercepts, slope, and constructions update live.
  - main:
    - complementary:
      - heading "TANGENT EXPLORER" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Ellipse
      - text: x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 a
      - spinbutton "Ellipse semi-major axis a": "5"
      - text: b
      - spinbutton "Ellipse semi-minor axis b": "3"
      - text: Parameter θ 0°
      - slider "Ellipse tangent angle theta": "60"
      - text: 180°
      - status: θ = 60°
      - article:
        - paragraph: Tangent at P(a cos θ,b sin θ)
        - strong: ● P(2.5000, 2.5981)
      - article:
        - paragraph: Tangent equation
        - text: x cosθ/a + y sinθ/b = 1
        - strong: 0.1000x + 0.2887y = 1
      - article:
        - paragraph: Local slope of tangent
        - text: "-b cosθ/(a sinθ) = -0.3464"
      - article:
        - paragraph: Intercepts
        - text: x-intercept (10.0000,0) y-intercept (0,3.4641)
    - heading "ELLIPSE AND TANGENT" [level=2]

    - text: ● P(a cosθ,b sinθ) — Tangent -- Radius OP ● Foci (±c,0) — Axes a=5, b=3, c=√(a²-b²)=4.0000
    - complementary:
      - article:
        - heading "RADIUS-TO-TANGENT CONSTRUCTION" [level=2]
        - img: O(0,0) P(a cosθ,b sinθ)
        - paragraph: Tangent at P is perpendicular to the ellipse gradient direction.
        - paragraph: Its local slope is the negative reciprocal of the normal slope.
      - article:
        - heading "EQUATION VERIFIER" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Substitute P into the tangent equation.
        - paragraph: x cosθ/a + y sinθ/b = 1
        - paragraph:
          - text: cos²θ + sin²θ = 1.0000
